name: robots/shupx__swarm_sync_sim
title: swarm_sync_sim lock-step simulation clock
intro: swarm_sync_sim lock-step simulation clock, adapted from shupx/swarm_sync_sim. It reads `read_sim_clock` and `read_clock_online`; runs `pause` and `resume`. `pause`: pause the simulation clock with /sss_clock_control; /clock holds after at most the regulator's pending 0.01 s step until a client resumes it. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
